title: The Men Sent to Search Canaan
reflectionText: Moses sent the men to look at the land, its people, its cities, and its fruit. At Eshcol, two men carried one cluster of grapes on a staff. What do you notice in the fruit they carried after hearing Moses’ questions about the land?
